test-italy-villa-castelletti.name: Villa Castelletti
test-italy-villa-castelletti.tagline: Just 15 minutes from the center of Florence, Villa Castelletti is a magnificent
test-italy-villa-castelletti.description:
Just 15 minutes from the center of Florence, Villa Castelletti is a magnificent country residence originating from a 15th-century farmhouse. In the shade of a centuries-old park, it is the ideal location for the most sought-after weddings and the most sumptuous events.

Spaces and capacities

The property offers one of the oldest Tuscan villas for your wedding, with magnificent views over the city.

The estate has five rooms with a variety of capacities:

Winter Garden Room, with a capacity of up to 550 seated people, is characterized by a large sliding window overlooking the park

Sala Rossa, for up to 80 seated guests, is characterized by a vaulted ceiling and terracotta floor.

Green Room, for up to 70 seated guests, characterized by a green marble floor.

Sala del Teatro, for up to 90 seated guests, with a wooden ceiling and a terracotta floor.

Sala del Capitano, for up to 200 seated guests, with wooden ceilings, large windows, and French windows that flood the room with natural light.

The structure also has a "cellar floor" with 5 spaces of different capacities, which can be used separately or with the possibility of blending them.

Offered services

The venue offers a precious location and an expert staff who will coordinate the wedding with you, from the first arrival to the end of the banquet. More specifically, the establishment offers you the following services:

Complete logistic assistance

Exclusive catering and banqueting service

Floral decorations

Musical entertainment

Possibility of celebrating civil marriage

Vintage car rental

Other services

Villa Castelletti also has:

Hotel with 21 accommodations, including suites and charming apartments

Pool area

Conference center with five rooms and two auditoriums

Free internet

Wellness treatments

test-italy-villa-demetra-resort.name: Villa Demetra Resort
test-italy-villa-demetra-resort.tagline: Timeless elegance in the heart of the Valley of the Temples
test-italy-villa-demetra-resort.description:
Timeless elegance in the heart of the Valley of the Temples

Villa Demetra Resort is a finely restored ancient noble estate that welcomes its guests into an oasis of discreet luxury, where history, nature, and authenticity blend in perfect balance.

Located in Agrigento and nestled in the extraordinary setting of the Valley of the Temples, the villa is surrounded by a pristine landscape that offers privacy, beauty, and tranquility. An exclusive, protected, and privileged place, ideal for experiencing unique moments.

Among centuries-old olive trees, fragrant citrus trees, and the gentle whisper of the wind blowing through the Doric columns, every stay becomes a timeless experience.

A unique location for exclusive events

Villa Demetra Resort is the ideal setting for private events, ceremonies, and special occasions. The historic setting and breathtaking scenery of the Valley of the Temples make every event unique, far from mass tourism and immersed in an atmosphere of rare elegance.

Every detail is carefully curated to excite and leave an indelible memory.

Experiences and services

Elegant spaces in a context of inestimable historical and landscape value

Cuisine inspired by Sicilian tradition, made with local excellence

High-level services and comfort

Personalized and tailor-made events

Experience Villa Demetra

A haven of excellence, where time seems to slow down and beauty takes center stage.

Browse the gallery and contact us for more information on the services we offer.

test-italy-villa-demetra-resort.tagline_cn: 寺庙谷中心的永恒优雅
test-italy-villa-demetra-resort.description_cn:
寺庙谷中心的永恒优雅

Villa Demetra Resort 是一座经过精心修复的古老贵族庄园，欢迎客人来到一片低调奢华的绿洲，这里历史、自然和真实性完美融合。

别墅位于阿格里真托，坐落在寺庙谷的非凡环境中，周围环绕着原始景观，提供隐私、美丽和宁静。这是一个独特、受保护且享有特权的地方，是体验独特时刻的理想场所。

周围有数百年历史的橄榄树、芬芳的柑橘树，还有微风吹过多立克柱的轻柔耳语，每一次入住都成为一次永恒的体验。

举办独家活动的独特地点

Villa Demetra Resort 度假村是举办私人活动、仪式和特殊场合的理想场所。寺庙谷的历史背景和令人惊叹的风景使每一次活动都独一无二，远离大众旅游，沉浸在罕见的优雅氛围中。

test-italy-weweddings.name: Weweddings
test-italy-weweddings.tagline: Weweddings are a professional wedding and event planning team that operates out
test-italy-weweddings.description:
Weweddings are a professional wedding and event planning team that operates out of Pistoia, Italy. Throughout the process, you can work closely with them to create a sophisticated and tasteful celebration that fits your vision. Past clients know them for their originality, expertise, and strict attention to detail.

Services Offered

Using only the best vendors, Weweddings is able to deliver some of the most exquisite resources that Italy has to offer. You’ll have access to incredible caterers, photographers, and videographers to elevate your big day. They are experienced at organizing destination weddings and can help you source the necessary documents to say ‘I do’ abroad. Decorations, music, lighting, transportation, and flowers are just a few of the things they can prove to design your event. Weweddings would love to play a part in bringing your special day to life.

Weweddings is a wedding planner for destination weddings in Florence, Italy.
